exact_question: When source assertions are observationally ambiguous between independent agreement and copied error, when is spending a limited query budget on a fallible provenance audit more useful than acquiring another assertion, under delayed gold feedback and changing source dependence?
material_delta: Active acquisition of uncertain lineage metadata is the intervention being evaluated; lineage is not supplied free or presumed correct. Match assertion histories before intervention so gains cannot come from extra information supplied only to the candidate.
scientific_reason: Disentangles information made available by an audit from recursive scheduling and tests when dependence is identifiable. A negative result is informative if no audit policy adds value at matched cost.
observable_inputs: Only acquired reports, observed headers and matured audit/label responses; no hidden lineage, drift flag or oracle accuracy.
actions_and_costs: request lineage audit with explicit error/delay/cost
primary_estimand: To be frozen: paired whole-stream expected decision loss including acquisition, abstention and false-alarm costs, rather than accuracy only during drift.
controls: same observation histories with/without paid audit
dependence change versus target change versus unchanged
recursive versus conventional sequential allocation with identical information
independent held-out generator and a defensible empirical source if feasible
literature_queries: provenance audit source selection truth discovery
active feature acquisition concept drift delayed
active multi-fidelity Bayesian online changepoint detection
